styles.base: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged hanji paper texture. Bright, clear, high contrast, faces large and readable. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.sil: Korean minhwa ink-wash painting on hanji paper mixed with bold acrylic painting: confident black ink outlines, textured acrylic brushstrokes. Huge blazing orange, red and gold sunset or deep blue moonlit sky with tiny white dots like stars, figures as solid black silhouettes, blue-violet shadows. Joseon dynasty. No text, no letters anywhere.
styles.web: Korean traditional minhwa folk painting in ink-wash damchae style, matching the style of the reference image: confident black ink brush outlines, soft muted watercolor washes of indigo, ochre, persimmon red and pine green on aged cream hanji paper. Bright and clear, faces large and readable. No text, no letters anywhere.

characters.SUNDEOK: a young Joseon wife with a gentle round face in a faded pale-green jeogori and dark-blue skirt, hair in a low bun with a plain wooden hairpin
characters.MOTHERINLAW: a stern plump older noblewoman in a purple silk jeogori and navy silk skirt with a silver hairpin in her gray bun
characters.OKBUN: a spoiled teenage girl in a pink silk jeogori and red skirt with a long black braid and red ribbon
characters.HUSBAND: a young Joseon man in a white hanbok and black gat hat
characters.OLDKIM: a frail old village man with a thin white beard in worn gray hemp clothes
characters.MOTHER: a poor middle-aged peasant woman in patched white cotton hanbok with a white head scarf

scenes.S01: [SIL] Snowy night at a ruined thatched hut at the foot of a mountain: an old noblewoman kneeling in the snow before a young woman holding an oil lamp in the doorway.
scenes.S02: [WEB] Scene at a snowy thatched hut at night, two clear roles: 1. LEFT, standing in the doorway with warm lamplight behind her: SUNDEOK holding a steaming bowl of soup. 2. RIGHT, on her knees in the snow with head bowed: MOTHERINLAW, her silk skirt soaked with snow. BACKGROUND: several earthenware jars covered with snow. The humble young woman is the dignified one; the rich old woman is the one humbled.
scenes.S05: A peaceful Joseon mountain village in Chungcheong province in spring: thatched-roof houses, one larger tiled-roof house with a big jar terrace, blossoming trees and green hills. No people.
scenes.S06: In front of a poor thatched hut, MOTHER hands a small round earthenware jar to SUNDEOK dressed in simple bridal clothes, both teary-eyed.
scenes.S07: MOTHERINLAW stands on the wooden veranda of a tiled-roof house, sneering with her nose in the air, a silver hairpin shining in her hair.
scenes.S08: OKBUN pinches her nose and turns her face away with a disgusted pout in a courtyard.
scenes.S09: Only one person in the picture: HUSBAND walking away down a country road between rice fields carrying a trader's pack on his back, turning to wave. Open sky, no calligraphy, nothing written.
scenes.S10: Before dawn in a traditional Joseon kitchen, SUNDEOK kneels feeding firewood into a clay stove under a big iron cauldron, sleeves rolled up, tired but steady.
scenes.S11: Only one person in the picture: SUNDEOK alone on a sunny back-yard jar terrace, lifting the lid of her small earthenware jar and smiling gently, big jars around her.
scenes.S12: At a low mud wall, SUNDEOK hands a bowl of warm soup over the wall to OLDKIM, who is coughing.
scenes.S13: MOTHERINLAW shouts furiously with her finger pointing, face red with anger, in a courtyard by the jar terrace.
scenes.S15: Morning in a woman's room: MOTHERINLAW stands in shock beside an open empty jewelry box on a low dresser, both hands on her cheeks, screaming.
scenes.S16: [WEB] Scene in a dim room at dawn, one clear role: OKBUN kneeling and secretly sliding a silver hairpin under folded clothes at the bottom of an open wicker clothes chest, looking back over her shoulder with a sly grin. Nobody else in the room.
scenes.S17: [WEB] Scene in a Joseon house courtyard, three clear roles: 1. CENTER: an overturned wicker clothes chest with clothes spilled and a shining silver hairpin on top. 2. LEFT: MOTHERINLAW holding up the hairpin and glaring. 3. RIGHT: SUNDEOK pale with shock, hands raised. BACKGROUND: OKBUN hiding a smirk behind her sleeve.
scenes.S18: [SIL] Dusk in a courtyard, only one figure: a stern old noblewoman standing with her back half turned, arm stretched out pointing at a big open wooden gate.
scenes.S19: [SIL] Sunset at the big gate of a tiled-roof house: a young woman walking out carrying a small jar on her head, the gate closing behind her.
scenes.S20: [SIL] A lonely mountain path at dusk, a small figure of a woman with a jar on her head walking toward a tiny ruined hut far away.
scenes.S21: Inside a ruined thatched hut with a hole in the roof letting in light, SUNDEOK sits sewing by the wall, her small earthenware jar beside her.
scenes.S23: [SIL] Bitter winter night over a silent village: snow on thatched roofs, no chimney smoke, a few dim lights, bare black trees.
scenes.S24: MOTHERINLAW locks a big iron padlock on a storehouse door, glancing around suspiciously, snow on the ground.
scenes.S25: Only one person in the picture: SUNDEOK kneeling at the doorway of a humble thatched hut in winter, looking down thoughtfully at her small earthenware jar. Plain mud walls, nothing written anywhere.
scenes.S26: SUNDEOK stirs a big steaming iron cauldron over an outdoor fire in the snow, bundles of bellflower roots and mugwort beside her.
scenes.S27: [WEB] Scene inside a poor village room in winter, three clear roles: 1. CENTER, kneeling: SUNDEOK spoon-feeding warm porridge. 2. LYING UNDER A QUILT: OLDKIM, sick. 3. BESIDE HIM: a small feverish child wrapped in a blanket. Warm, gentle mood.
scenes.S28: A line of thin villagers holding empty bowls waiting in the snow in front of a small thatched hut, steam rising from a cauldron.
scenes.S29: SUNDEOK leans over her nearly empty earthenware jar, scraping the bottom with a wooden spoon, worried expression.
scenes.S30: [WEB] Close-up on a wooden floor: an earthenware jar tipped on its side, beside it an opened oiled-paper bundle revealing dried medicinal herb roots and a small folded white cotton cloth. Only hands of a young woman visible. No writing anywhere.
scenes.S31: [WEB] Close-up of a small white cotton cloth embroidered with simple colorful thread pictures, no letters at all: on the left, a hand putting herb roots into a jar; on the right, a hand offering a bowl of soup to another hand.
scenes.S32: SUNDEOK sits on the floor of the hut hugging a small white embroidered cloth to her chest, crying with a trembling smile, soft window light.
scenes.S33: In front of a thatched hut, SUNDEOK and village women pour beans and salt together into several new earthenware jars on a small jar terrace, cheerful and warm.
scenes.S35: [SIL] Moonlit night, a locked storehouse with a big padlock, silhouettes of rats swarming out from gaps under the door.
scenes.S36: OKBUN lies sick under a thick quilt, face flushed with fever, sweat on her forehead, in a dim room.
scenes.S37: [SIL] Moonlit night, a lone old woman standing at the open wooden gate of a Korean tiled-roof house wall, shouting into an empty snowy village lane.
scenes.S38: MOTHERINLAW slumps down on the floor beside a sick girl under a quilt, stunned and pale, hands limp in her lap.
scenes.S39: OLDKIM, healthy again with rosy cheeks, stands at a gate in the snow speaking earnestly and pointing toward the mountain.
scenes.S40: [SIL] Heavy snowfall on a mountain path at night, only one figure: an old woman bent forward carrying a girl piggyback on her back, struggling through deep snow.
scenes.S41: [SIL] Snowy night, a small thatched hut glowing with warm lamplight through its paper window, ten earthenware jars covered with snow standing in front.
scenes.S42: [WEB] Scene at a snowy thatched hut at night, three clear roles: 1. DOORWAY: SUNDEOK holding an oil lamp, surprised. 2. CENTER, kneeling in the snow with hands pressed together begging: MOTHERINLAW. 3. BESIDE HER: OKBUN lying weak on a straw mat wrapped in a quilt.
scenes.S43: Close-up portrait of only one woman: SUNDEOK's face lit by warm lamplight, lips pressed together, eyes glistening with painful memories, snowflakes falling around her.
scenes.S44: [WEB] Scene at a snowy hut doorway at night, two clear roles: 1. SUNDEOK bending down and gently lifting MOTHERINLAW up from the snow by both arms. 2. MOTHERINLAW rising, crying. Warm lamplight from the open door.
scenes.S45: [SIL] Inside a hut at night lit by one oil lamp, the shadow of a young woman placing a wet cloth on the forehead of a girl lying down, warm glow.
scenes.S46: Dawn light in a humble hut, OKBUN sits up under a quilt crying with tears streaming, holding out both hands apologetically.
scenes.S47: [WEB] Scene inside a humble hut at dawn, two clear roles: 1. LEFT: SUNDEOK kneeling and offering a steaming bowl of soybean paste soup with both hands. 2. RIGHT: MOTHERINLAW receiving it, tears falling into the bowl. Soft morning light.
scenes.S48: Spring in the village with blossoms, HUSBAND just returned with his pack, holding SUNDEOK's rough hands tenderly, villagers smiling behind.
scenes.S49: Only one person in the picture: MOTHERINLAW walking proudly along a spring country road, balancing a small round earthenware jar on top of her head, steadying it with both hands raised to the jar, blossoming trees around.
scenes.S50: A bright spring day at a tiled-roof house: the storehouse doors wide open, a jar terrace full of earthenware jars, SUNDEOK handing jars of soybean paste to happy villagers.
